 Dms Campus, 5th Floor, No.359, Anna Salai, Teynampet,
 Chennai  06.
 2. The Designated Officer,
 Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department,
 Food Safety Wing, Race Course Road,
 Tiruchirappalli. ... Respondents 
 Prayer :  Writ petition filed under Article 226 of the  Constitution of India, to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the s  respondent to de-seal the petitioner's shop, Selvaraj Maligai, situ  Vathalai Salai, T.Puthur Post, Musiri Taluk, Trichy District by  considering the petitioner's representation dated 22.04.2024 to the  respondents. 
 For Petitioner : Mr.S.Jayaseelan  For Respondents : Mr.Veerakathiravan,
 Additional Advocate General,
 assisted by,
 Mr.K.Balasubramanian,
 Special Government Pleader.

1 2. Since thirty days waiting period has elapsed and that the petitioner has also remitted the penalty amount, there can be no objection for de-sealing the petition mentioned premises. The respondents are directed to de-seal the petition mentioned premises forthwith and without any delay. This writ petition stands allowed. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
